announcements.title: Restart Posterior Sampling accepted at ECCV 2026
announcements.summary: Our work on diffusion-based posterior sampling for inverse problems has been accepted at ECCV 2026.
announcements.body: Solving Diffusion Inverse Problems with Restart Posterior Sampling, with Joseph G. Makin, has been accepted at ECCV 2026. RePS uses pretrained diffusion models to solve linear and nonlinear inverse problems.

announcements.title: New paper in PLOS Computational Biology
announcements.summary: Deep Neural Networks Explain Spiking Activity in Auditory Cortex is published.
announcements.body: Our work studies how representations learned by deep neural networks explain spiking activity in auditory cortex. Code and analysis tools are available on GitHub.

writing.title: How Neural Networks Learn: A Probabilistic Viewpoint
writing.summary: Understanding neural network loss functions through probability, entropy, and cross-entropy.
writing.body: A probabilistic introduction to neural network training: entropy, cross-entropy, KL divergence, and the loss functions used for classification and regression.
